question: Should `openclaw/openclaw-secops` accept the v7.5.1 autolabeler Action code under the existing `pull_request_target` workflow and permissions?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes executed third-party automation code; green checks and ClawSweeper cannot decide repository risk tolerance for that workflow surface.

options.title: Approve the pinned autolabeler bump
options.body: Accept the verified upstream v7.5.1 commit under the existing SHA pin and unchanged permissions after workflow-owner review.

options.title: Review with the sibling release-drafter bump
options.body: Evaluate this together with https://github.com/openclaw/notcrawl/pull/56 so all release-drafter references move to the same upstream release intentionally.

options.title: Recreate as a grouped update
options.body: Close or recreate the split Dependabot updates if maintainers prefer one coordinated release-drafter dependency PR.

recommendation.title: Approve the pinned autolabeler bump
recommendation.body: Accept the verified upstream v7.5.1 commit under the existing SHA pin and unchanged permissions after workflow-owner review.
